name: Rulesaccept
author: kirin
short: Rules acceptance with button and modal.
description: Lets users accept rules via a button and modal, and assigns a role upon acceptance.
install_msg: Rulesaccept cog loaded. Use `[p]sendrules` to send the rules acceptance button.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not retain per-user Config records. It posts the accepting member's Discord ID and submitted acceptance text to the configured Discord log channel, where server log-retention policy applies.
